question: In which year the Asian Games were held for the second time in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1982.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Asian Games, also known as Asiad, is a continental multi-sport event held every four years among athletes from all over Asia.
 
• The Games were regulated by the Asian Games Federation from the first Games in New Delhi, India, until the 1978 Games.
 
• It was firstly organized in the 1951 Asian Games in New Delhi, India.
 
• New Delhi, the national capital of India, has hosted the Asian Games on two occasions: the inaugural 1951 Asian Games and the 1982 Asian Games.
 
• Asian Games, 2023 will be a multi-sport event celebrated in Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] Additional Information__

 
• There have been nine nations that have hosted the Asian Games. Forty-six nations have participated in the Games, including Israel, which was excluded from the Games altogether after Israel managed to win a silver medal (in their last participation) at the 1974 Asian Games in Iran. The most recent games were held in Jakarta and Palembang, Indonesia from 18 August to 2 September 2018.
 
• The Asian Games Movement uses symbols to represent the ideals embodied in the Asian Games charter.
